rule: An entry needs all three: the same text pattern in a Linux control run of the same game version with no mod enabled; a source no mod file can override or replace; and a record of pattern, reason, control-run date, game version and date added.

entries.pattern: ^Could not find DLC '[^']+' in store backend\.$
entries.reason: The Linux build's store layer reports three DLCs it cannot find in its store backend (Anniversary Pack, Poland: United and Ready, Rocket Launcher Unit Pack). The engine writes these lines while it registers DLCs, before any mod loads; no mod file can change them.

controlRun.platform: isolated Linux run (WSL), no mod enabled, main menu
